residents.filters: TELFS in (3,4,5) (not employed); TUDIARYDAY 2-6; weight TUFNWGTP; no occupation filter
residents.state_rule: home is TEWHERE 1; any other known place or mode of travel is away; TEWHERE < 0 (sleep, grooming - place not collected) carries the previous known state forward, and a diary that opens unknown takes the first known state that follows
residents.caveat: National, all weekdays, not New York. The curves time the sandbox's resident trips; they do not decide who makes one.

filters: TELFS in (1,2); TUDIARYDAY 2-6; TEIO1OCD 0010-3550 (management, business, financial and professional, 2018 Census Occupation Classification); weight TUFNWGTP
travel_note: TEWHERE 12-21 and 99 are modes of travel, not places. A person commuting is neither at home nor at the workplace, and this curve counts only TEWHERE 2.
source: ATUS 2003-2025 activity and respondent files, BLS, atusact-0325.zip + atusresp-0325.zip, joined on TUCASEID
